title: GoldenRetrievalBenchmarkCaseSchema
description: Canonical JSON Schema for Phase 1E Golden Retrieval Benchmark Cases

case_id.description: Unique case identifier. Two families: retrieval benchmark cases (E1-001...) and KPI Prompt Library Sales cases (SAL-USE-01, SAL-MAN-01, SAL-HOD-01, SAL-CXO-01) which keep the spreadsheet's own ids for traceability

category.description: Benchmark category. The first 13 classify retrieval behaviour; KPI_BUSINESS_QUESTION marks end-to-end business questions from the KPI Prompt Library, which are graded on plan correctness rather than retrieval mechanics

source.description: Source tier classification. KPI_LIBRARY marks cases taken verbatim from the KPI Prompt Library spreadsheet

severity.description: Business impact severity rating upon retrieval failure

question.description: The natural language user query being evaluated

conversation.description: List of prior conversation turn objects for multi-turn evaluation (empty [] for single turn)

datasource_ref.description: Logical datasource identifier (e.g. 'Chatbot'); must not contain credentials or physical table names

metrics.description: List of expected business metric names (e.g. ['Sales', 'Qty'])

dimensions.description: List of expected business dimension names (e.g. ['City', 'Brand'])

values.description: List of expected resolved entity values (e.g. ['CHENNAI'])

followup_context_applied.description: Whether previous turn context inheritance must be applied

dominant_candidate.description: Optional dominant candidate string when ambiguity is present

implementation_status.description: Optional implementation status of the capability (defaults to CURRENTLY_IMPLEMENTED if omitted)

allowed_variations.description: Optional list of acceptable question phrase variations

must_not.description: Optional list of terms or entity mappings that must NOT be present in resolution

expected_plan.description: Optional expected AnalyticalPlan. Present on plan-scoped cases (KPI library); absent on legacy retrieval-only cases. Grades layers [1]-[3] independently of whether the data can execute it

mode.description: The analysis mode the plan must select

metric.description: Primary business metric name, or null when the question names none

entity.description: The entity slot, when the question names one

ranking.description: Expected ranking slot, when the question asks for top/bottom N

diagnostic.description: Expected diagnostic slot, required when mode is DIAGNOSTIC

candidate_dimensions.description: Dimensions the decomposition should test as candidate drivers

assumptions_expected.description: Defaults the system SHOULD fill and record in assumptions_made (e.g. 'monthly grain assumed'). Empty list means the question is fully specified and no assumption is warranted. Used to test assume-and-record instead of interrupting

data_answerable.description: Whether the CURRENT live tables can execute this case. 'yes' = fully answerable; 'partial' = answerable at a coarser grain or with a proxy metric; 'no' = required fields do not exist. Plan-level grading runs on all cases; execution-level grading runs only on 'yes'

missing_data.description: For 'partial'/'no' cases: the specific fields or tables required to make this answerable. This is the concrete data request list to take to the business

notes.description: Human-readable explanation of why this golden expectation is correct
